title: BIOLOG domain event envelope
description: ADR-0001 Decisions 2.4 and 3.6, extended by ADR-0003 Decision 2. Events are immutable facts: they carry schema_version and the aggregate_version they describe, never a version of their own.

schema_version.description: Shape of payload. Additive changes keep it; breaking changes create a new version.

causation_id.description: What caused this event. REQUIRED (AC02) and explicitly null for a root event, so an unstated cause cannot be confused with no cause.

occurred_at.description: Claimed by the producer. At the edge this is a device clock claim, not a fact. Never used for security ordering.

received_at.description: Stamped by the server on intake. Authoritative for ordering.

aggregate_version.description: Version of the aggregate this event describes (ADR-0001 3.1). A fact about the state, not a version OF the event - so it does not make the event mutable. Lets a consumer order two events about one aggregate without trusting a clock.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. For the retry-prone writes in ADR-0001 3.4; scoped to tenant plus operation.

not.$comment: An event is a fact. A bare `version` would imply it can be updated; the version of the AGGREGATE it describes is carried as aggregate_version instead (ADR-0003 Decision 2).
